subset.rationale: Whole namespace; trivial POD fixture to prove the pipeline.
Self-referential data structure (Node holds std::vector<Node>). Coverage for recursive types + vector-of-self member binding. NOT a BINDER-0004 regression (builds pre-fix too).
Whole namespace; abstract Shape + concrete Circle to prove codegen trampolines and Python-overrides-C++-virtual dispatch.

Four layers of REAL fmt surface, all differentially checked vs native fmt. (1) fmt's enums color (~140 CSS-color enumerators)/terminal_color/emphasis, reflected directly. (2) fmt's real concrete class fmt::format_int (its fast int->string formatter): ctor overloads + str()/c_str()/data()/size() bind, private member templates skipped. (3) fmt's real FORMATTING API bound DIRECTLY from its own function-template instantiations fmt::to_string<int/double/long long> (the binder binds fmt's own symbol, not a wrapper). fmt's format()/print() front-ends take a CONSTEVAL format_string<Args...> first parameter not constructible at runtime from Python, so they are intrinsically not directly bindable; to_string<T>/format_int are the directly-bindable formatting entry points. (4) A fixture namespace fmttest of concrete wrappers over the runtime fmt::format engine that drives the remaining Tier-2 themes: keyword arguments (P3096 names -> nb::arg), std::string/std::vector casters incl. fmt::join, and the member-function-template gap (Formatter::apply<T> skipped while ordinary members bind).
skipped_features: fmt::format/format_to/print/println front-ends: intrinsically not directly bindable (consteval format_string<Args...> first param); runtime path exercised via fmttest wrappers
fmt::format_int private member templates format_signed/format_unsigned (binder skips member templates)
Formatter::apply<T> member function template (binder gracefully skips member templates)

subset.rationale: glm is entirely templates; bind concrete vec3/vec4. Components live in an anonymous union (not exposed, BINDER-0002); usable surface is constructors, operator[]->__getitem__, static length(). Free-function API is function templates (not auto-bound).

nlohmann::json = basic_json<>; the whole real value type is reflected (no facade). Value-ingestion/extraction is all member templates (correctly skipped), so jsontest helper factories supply populated inputs; the binder still exposes the real dump()/is_*()/size()/operator[]/== surface under test. Previously OUTCOME B: reflecting basic_json crashed clang-p2996 — originally mis-attributed to a constexpr/SLoc-exhaustion ceiling (TC-0002), but root-caused to a use-after-free in Sema (fixed in the pinned toolchain). With the fix + a raised constexpr-step budget, the real class binds.
skipped_features: all member templates: get<T>/parse/get_to/emplace_back/compat-ctors (Python uses jsontest factories instead)

subset.rationale: linalg is entirely templates; vec<float,3> is the only concrete auto-bindable surface (data x/y/z, ctors, operator[]). Free-function API is function templates (not auto-bound).
